name: 57754 · Lead, SD
findings: ZIP 57754 (Lead) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57754 (Lead) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 57754 (Lead) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).
